title: Examen Test Suite
description: Declarative test suite for HTTP and CLI checks. Supports per-test bindings (let), suite-wide bindings (vars), generators, forEach iteration, cross-test capture, and a small expression language for templating.

seed.description: Optional seed for the runner's PRNG. When set, uuid/random helpers become deterministic so a failure can be reproduced exactly.

defaultTimeoutMs.description: Default per-step timeout applied to http and cli steps that don't specify their own timeoutMs.

vars.description: Suite-scope bindings. Evaluated once at startup. Referenced as ${vars.name} or ${name} when unambiguous.

generators.description: Named template factories that yield a fresh value on every reference. Referenced as ${gen.name}.

bindingMap.description: Map of names to values. Values may be any JSON type and may contain ${...} template expressions.

generatorMap.description: Map of generator names to template strings. Each call yields a fresh evaluation.

id.description: Optional identifier. Required if other tests reference this test's captures via ${tests.<id>...}.

name.description: Human-readable test name. Shown in output.

dependsOn.description: Test id(s) that must pass before this test runs. If any dependency failed or was skipped, this test is skipped.

skipIf.description: Expression evaluated per case. If truthy, this case is skipped.

as.description: Variable name to bind each forEach item to. Required when forEach is set.

keyBy.description: Expression evaluated per iteration to key captured values. Enables ${tests.<id>[<key>].<name>} lookups. Optional; if absent, captures are indexed by integer position.

let.description: Case-scope bindings. Evaluated once per case (after vars/forEach binding, before setup). Visible to setup, the main step, capture, expect, and teardown.

setup.description: Optional pre-step. Runs before the main step. Its response is not asserted against; use it to prepare state. Its capture block (if present) populates let-like bindings before the main step runs.

capture.description: Bindings populated after the main step from its response. Visible to expect, teardown, and (for the entire test) to other tests as ${tests.<id>.<name>}.

expect.description: List of assertions evaluated after the main step.

teardown.description: Optional post-step. Always runs if reached, even when expect fails. Use to clean up state.

timeoutMs.description: Total timeout for the test case (setup + http/cli + expect + teardown). Overrides defaultTimeoutMs.

forEach.description: Either a reference expression (e.g. 'vars.hosts') that resolves to an array, or an inline array literal.

body.description: Any JSON-serializable value. Sent as JSON unless Content-Type is overridden.

command.description: Executable name or full path. Resolved against PATH unless absolute.

env.description: Additional env vars. Merged with the runner's env unless shell:strict is true.

shell.description: If true, command + args are passed through /bin/sh -c. Otherwise the command is executed directly.

auth.description: HTTP auth. Either basic { user, pass } or bearer { bearer }.

assertion.description: Single-key object: { <path>: <matcher-or-shorthand> }. Path uses dot/bracket notation: 'body.state.id', 'body[0].id', 'body[*].id', 'headers."content-type"', 'status', 'exitCode', 'stdout', 'stderr', 'duration_ms'. Shorthand: a primitive value is interpreted as { equals: <value> }.

matcher.description:
Matchers:
- equals/notEquals: deep equality
- exists: bool — value is/is not undefined
- type: 'string'|'number'|'integer'|'boolean'|'object'|'array'|'null'
- matches/notMatches: regex (string)
- contains/notContains: substring (string) or element (array)
- in/notIn: value is/is not in the provided array
- lengthEquals/lengthGte/lengthLte: array/string length
- gt/gte/lt/lte: numeric comparison
- all: nested matcher applied to every element of an array (use with [*])
- js: escape-hatch JS expression evaluated with (value, ctx) → boolean
